# Isaiah Chapter 61 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 158r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_061_page_001.jpg

---

**61:1** The-spirit [ruach] of-the-Lord [Adonai] YHWH [is] upon-me, because YHWH has-anointed [mashach] me to-bring-good-news [levasser] to-the-afflicted [anavim]; he-has-sent-me [shelachani] to-bind-up [lachavosh] the-brokenhearted [le-nishberei-lev], to-proclaim [liqro] to-the-captives [li-shevuyim] liberty [deror] and-to-the-prisoners [la-asurim] opening [peqach-qoach] [of the prison];

**61:2** to-proclaim [liqro] the-year [shenat] of-the-LORD's-favor [ratson la-YHWH] and-the-day of-vengeance [naqam] of-our-God; to-comfort [lenachem] all who-mourn [avelim].

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Isaiah 61 — "The Year of the LORD's Favor" — formal English rendering preserving prophetic structure and the distinctive voice of Third Isaiah (chs.56-66).

*— LOGOS*
